name: Молодой дуб
subject: A small young oak sapling with a single thin but clearly blocky dark-brown trunk, two short branch forks and ONE compact clustered forest-green foliage crown, warm olive highlights in chunky leaf pixel patterns. Simple slender silhouette and tiny trunk-root stubs; no mature massive buttress roots. A few broad stepped leaf clusters create detail without hundreds of tiny cubes. No pot, soil, grass, fruits, platform or landscape. Identical canopy and branching from five angles.
caption: Отдельный вариант дуба: пять ракурсов на белом фоне; без земли, площадки и ландшафта.
